definitions.explanation: The person who receives something, such as a package, letter, payment, or insurance benefit. Used in postal, financial, and legal contexts.

examples.japanese: {受取人|うけとりにん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}いて→書く：00477_kaku⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{保険金|ほけんきん}→保険金：15653_hokenkin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{受取人|うけとりにん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{変更|へんこう}する→変更する：30779_henkousuru⟧。
⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{受取人|うけとりにん}⟦{本人|ほんにん}→本人：03627_honnin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧しか⟦{渡|わた}せません→渡す：02442_watasu⟧。
examples.english: The package can only be handed to the recipient in person.

notes:
{受取人|うけとりにん} is the person designated to receive something — a package, letter, payment, or insurance benefit.

FORMS:
⟦{受取|うけとり}→受取：04100_uketori⟧ (receipt) + ⟦{人|にん}→〜人：00658_nin⟧ (person)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {受取人|うけとりにん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{住所|じゅうしょ}→住所：01430_juusho⟧ (recipient's address)
- {受取人|うけとりにん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{指定|してい}→指定：00373_shitei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to designate a recipient)
- {受取人|うけとりにん}⟦{不在|ふざい}→不在：11302_fuzai⟧ (recipient not home)
- ⟦{保険金|ほけんきん}→保険金：15653_hokenkin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{受取人|うけとりにん} (insurance beneficiary)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{差出人|さしだしにん}→差出人：06316_sashidashinin⟧ (sender)

REGISTER:
Formal. Used on forms, in postal/financial documents, and legal contexts. In casual speech, {届|とど}け{先|さき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ or ⟦もらう→もらう：00520_morau⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ might be used instead.
